scenario: An authenticated fixture recruiter sends governed synthetic text and images through the real Agent runtime, inspects ordered tools and terminal receipts, and compares frozen expectations without external effects.
frozen_evidence: artifact-manifest.json: r1 runtime and r2 post-review validation
mobile-ux-review.json: independent responsive and accessibility packet

review_plan.reason: The feature changes the builder and recruiter testing loop, target selection, and regression triage workflow.
The feature captures conversation-shaped text and images, links them to Agent providers, and exposes lifecycle and recovery boundaries.
The Eval entrance and long diagnostic receipt must remain operable and truthful on narrow responsive surfaces.
The feature introduces Agent evaluations and therefore needs validity, reliability, held-out-set, and prohibited-ranking review.

strengths: One governed action reaches the real Agent, ordered tools, terminal receipt, and inspectable trace.
missing_evidence: Saved suites, baseline comparison, index filters, and measured builder-time improvement remain unproven.
open_questions: Should saved cases pin a Pursuit revision or follow the latest synthetic fixture revision?

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action
strengths: Same-account synthetic authorization, content hashes, immutable input manifests, zero external effects, and no hidden chain-of-thought collection are directly proven.
missing_evidence: Automated stale-trace recovery, raw-plus-derived deletion, and remote-provider admission remain unproven.
open_questions: Should Eval artifacts expire sooner than ordinary governed evidence unless explicitly pinned?

reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery
strengths: Desktop hierarchy, textual status labels, direct routing, and responsive CSS intent are clear.
missing_evidence: The requested 390x844 override did not apply, so genuine mobile, zoom, keyboard, and screen-reader evidence is absent.
open_questions: Should mobile default to an exception-first summary with raw spans collapsed?

reviews.lens: validity, reliability, fairness, and evaluation design
strengths: Mechanical checks remain atomic, expected terminal and tool assertions are now executable, and semantic quality is not inferred from pipeline success.
missing_evidence: No held-out suite, human gold, live multimodal result, repeat stability, or paired baseline comparison exists.
open_questions: Which critical false pass should block release regardless of aggregate suite improvement?

top_findings.reason: The post-review slice can compare terminal and tool mechanics, but semantic_outcome_quality correctly remains needs_review and the four visible scenarios are not an independent test set.
top_findings.next_step: Version atomic semantic gold cases and an independently authored held-out suite before using the platform as a release gate.
top_findings.verification: Wrong terminal, tool, evidence, authority, and ranking outputs fail exact assertions on untouched cases with visible numerators and denominators.

top_findings.reason: The browser viewport override reported success but the runtime remained at desktop width, so no mobile completion claim is valid.
top_findings.next_step: Run upload, execution, failure, and trace inspection at true 390px and 320px CSS widths with keyboard and screen-reader coverage.
top_findings.verification: No overflow, clipping, focus trap, lost recovery action, or hidden failed Eval occurs at the tested widths and zoom levels.

top_findings.reason: The observed SQL failure left a Trace running until manual truthful recovery, and raw-plus-derived expiration or deletion is not exercised.
top_findings.next_step: Add idempotent aged-trace reconciliation and a complete evaluation-artifact deletion inventory.
top_findings.verification: Injected completion failure closes as recovered_error without duplicate receipts, and expiration removes bytes and previews while preserving only disclosed audit-safe tombstones.

agreements: The Eval entrance is genuinely connected to the web, backend, Agent, Provider, ordered tools, terminal receipt, governed artifacts, and deterministic checks.
Image transport is kept distinct from image understanding, and semantic quality is kept distinct from mechanical trace completeness.
Synthetic authorization, account scoping, immutable hashes, no external effects, and hidden-chain-of-thought non-collection are appropriate boundaries.
Expected terminal and ordered-tool assertions, unique target references, and the repaired file picker materially improve the frozen r1 artifact.
No reviewer issued a veto; remaining items are release-evidence gaps rather than authorization to widen data or action scope.
adjudication.rationale: The slice is a credible developer-facing Agent observability and test entrance, and two real browser runs prove text-plus-image lineage plus prompt-injection mechanics. The panel does not pass it as a complete Eval release gate because semantic gold, held-out coverage, true mobile evidence, automated terminal recovery, and deletion lifecycle proof remain absent.

next_tests.test: Create a versioned held-out synthetic suite with atomic expected evidence, terminal, tool, authority, abstention, and prohibited-ranking assertions.
next_tests.evidence_required: Untouched case manifest, human-adjudicated gold, per-assertion raw outcomes, slice numerators and denominators, and critical false-pass counts.
next_tests.pass_condition: Every critical boundary case has zero false pass and ordinary cases meet predeclared assertion thresholds without a candidate-level composite score.

next_tests.test: Run Agent Lab upload, error recovery, and trace inspection at true 390px and 320px CSS widths plus 200 percent zoom and keyboard traversal.
next_tests.evidence_required: Runtime viewport readback, full journey screenshots or recording, focus order, overflow measurements, and recovery-state receipts.
next_tests.pass_condition: No horizontal overflow, clipped control, focus trap, unreachable run action, or buried failed Eval occurs.

next_tests.test: Inject terminal completion failure and exercise expiration or authorized deletion across evaluation artifacts and derivatives.
next_tests.evidence_required: Original and reconciled Trace receipts, idempotency proof, raw and derived deletion inventory, authenticated content readback, and audit-safe tombstone output.
next_tests.pass_condition: The Trace closes truthfully without duplicates and governed bytes or previews are unavailable everywhere after the disclosed lifecycle boundary.
